### Extracto de la fuente
RESIST II PRODUCT INNOVATION OPEN CALL
Proyecto europeo que la convoca: Joint Cluster Initiatives (EUROCLUSTERS) for Europe’s recovery
Convocatoria en cascada (fondos europeos repartidos por un proyecto a terceros)
Identificador: SMP-COSME-2024-CLUSTER-01
Apertura: 2026-05-13
Cierre: 2027-07-13
es_SortDate: 2026-05-13T00:00:00.000+0000
beneficiaryAdministration: This open call aims to support European SMEs operating in the Mobility, Transport and Automotive ecosystem to develop new or significantly improved products/services for a better digital and environmental performance, allowing them to reach an increased level of resilience. The call is split into two cut-offs or application periods: the 1st one, launched on the 13th May 2026, will be opened for 2 months, while the 2nd one is expected to be launched in May 2027
 Eligible candidates 
 The Open call is addressed to SMEs working in the MTA ecosystem and located in EU Member States or SMP associated countries. SMEs can apply individually or in consortium (2-3 SMEs from different NUTS2 regions)
 Submission process 
 Applications to the RESIST II product innovation open call must be submitted electronically vía the following online platform . Eligible candidates must fill in the corresponding application form and upload the required annexes (resilience check + declaration of honour)
 Evaluation process in three stages 
 Verification of the admissibility and eligibility of applications
 Analysis of eligible proposals by at least 3 independent experts and scoring according to the 4 evaluation criteria specified in the Guide for applicants. Applications will then be ranked in descending order based on the scores obtained and the established tie-breaking rules
 The resulting ranking list must be reviewed by the consortium partners for its validation
description: Project cost categories may include:
 • External services and procurement (e.g. testing, certification, consulting, specialised technical services)
 • Equipment, components and consumables
 • Personnel costs of staff directly involved in the project
 • Prototype development, pilot testing and validation activities
title: Joint Cluster Initiatives (EUROCLUSTERS) for Europe’s recovery

furtherInformation: Applicants could receive up to 20,000€ in the case of individual projects and up to 30,000€/SME in the case of collaborative projects , with 90% of co-financing rate 
 Apart from the funding, selected SMEs will benefit from a complementary package of services provided during their projects implementation, including technical support, access to the pool of experts, training courses and internationalisation opportunities in third countries
